command:
# Generated by QSMbly for QSMxT git 9994450
qsmxt run <bids_dir> --mask phase-quality,threshold:otsu,dilate:1,fill-holes:0,erode:2 --vsharp-max-radius 18 --qsm-algorithm rts
configToml:
description = ""
schema_version = 2

[bet]
fractional_intensity = 0.5
gradient_threshold = 0.0
iterations = 1000
smoothness = 1.0
subdivisions = 4
voxel_scale = 1.0

[bg_removal]
algorithm = "vsharp"

[bg_removal.vsharp]
deconvolve = false
grid = "isotropic"
grid_spacing = 1.0
max_radius = 18.0
min_radius = 2.0
radius_step = 1.0
threshold = 0.2

[field_mapping]
b0_estimation = "weighted-avg"
b0_weight_assumed_t2star_ms = 40.0
b0_weight_type = "phase-snr"
bipolar_correction = false
coil_combination_sigma = [
    10.0,
    10.0,
    5.0,
]
laplacian_fft_pad = [
    64,
    64,
    64,
]
laplacian_solver = "dct"
phase_offset_removal = true
phase_offset_sigma_mm = [
    7.0,
    7.0,
    7.0,
]
qsmart_fit_percentile = 99.0
qsmart_fit_threshold = 40.0
qsmart_fit_threshold_mode = "percentile"
unwrapping_algorithm = "romeo"

[field_mapping.complex_fit]
max_iter = 30
reltol = 0.0001

[field_mapping.linear_fit]
estimate_offset = true
reliability_threshold_percentile = 90.0

[field_mapping.robust_fit]
downweight_level = 0.75
flag_ratio = 3.0
iterations = 3
loss = "tukey"

[field_mapping.romeo]
bestpath = false
correct_global = true
correct_regions = false
individual = true
mag_coherence = true
mag_weight = false
mag_weight2 = false
max_seeds = 1
merge_regions = false
phase_coherence = true
phase_gradient_coherence = true
phase_linearity = true
template = 0
temporal_uncertain_unwrapping = 0.5
wrap_addition = 0.0

[homogeneity]
nbox = 3
sigma_mm = 7.0

[inversion]
algorithm = "rts"

[inversion.rts]
delta = 0.15
gamma = 5.0
lsmr_iter = 4
max_iter = 20
mu = 100000.0
rho = 10.0
tau = 0.7
tol = 0.01

[masking]
combine = "or"
inhomogeneity_correction = true
inhomogeneity_method = "makehomogeneous"
refinements = []
two_pass = false

[[masking.sections]]
input = "phase-quality"

[masking.sections.generator]
method = "otsu"
op = "threshold"

[[masking.sections.refinements]]
iterations = 1
op = "dilate"

[[masking.sections.refinements]]
max_size = 0
op = "fill-holes"

[[masking.sections.refinements]]
iterations = 2
op = "erode"

[motion_correction]
chain = true
chain_levels = 3
enabled = false
min_ncc = 0.3
reference = "first"

[multi_orientation]
algorithm = "cosmos"
cosmos_max_iter = 100
cosmos_tol = 0.000001
force = false
group_by = ""
lambda = 0.0
magnitude_weighting = false
register = true

[n4]
bias_field_fwhm = 0.15
convergence_threshold = 0.0
histogram_bins = 200
max_iterations = [
    50,
    50,
    50,
    50,
]
mesh = [
    1,
    1,
    1,
]
shrink_factor = 4
spline_order = 3
wiener_noise = 0.01

[pipeline]
axial_resampling = false
crop_margin_mm = 32.0
crop_to_mask = false
do_analysis = false
do_chi_separation = false
do_qsm = true
do_r2map = false
do_r2primemap = false
do_r2starmap = false
do_segmentation = false
do_smwi = false
do_swi = false
do_t2starmap = false
export_dicom = false
fft_padding = false
ignore_slice_gap = false
obliquity_threshold = 10.0
output_space = "acquired"

[qsm]
reference = "mean"

[registration]
levels = 5
max_evaluations = 5000
max_iterations = 20
max_samples = 200000
min_overlap = 0.25
rotation_step_deg = 3.0
tolerance = 0.00001
translation_step_mm = 3.0

[segmentation]
flip_averaging = true
sigma_smoothing = 0.5
topology_cleanup = true
version = "v1"

[separation]
algorithm = "r2star-qsm"
r2prime_strategy = "auto"

[separation.chi_sep_ilsqr]
cg_max_iter = 30
cg_tol = 0.05
dr_neg = 137.0
dr_pos = 137.0
lambda1 = 1.0
max_iter = 30
percentage = 0.9
r2p_max = 30.0
r2p_min = 1.0
tol = 0.01

[separation.chi_sep_ilsqr.qsm_ilsqr]
max_iter = 100
pad_mm = 12.0
tol = 0.001

[separation.chi_sep_medi]
cg_max_iter = 100
cg_tol = 0.01
dr_neg = 137.0
dr_pos = 137.0
lambda_cpl = 100.0
lambda_dia = 30.0
lambda_para = 30.0
max_iter = 10
percentage = 0.3
tol = 0.1

[separation.chi_sepnet]
patch = [
    192,
    192,
    128,
]

[separation.decompose]
chi_bound = 0.5
max_lm_iter = 30
n_inner = 10

[separation.hc_chisep]
bin_hz = 0.25
dr_pos_3t = 137.0

[separation.r2primenet]
ignore_field_mismatch = false
patch = [
    192,
    192,
    128,
]

[separation.r2star_qsm]
r_const_3t = 274.0

[separation.susep_net]

[separation.wavesep]
alpha = 0.2
dr_neg = 137.0
dr_pos = 137.0
lambda = 0.02
max_iter = 100
tol = 0.001
wavelet_order = 4

[smwi]
mip_window = 4
power = 4.0
threshold_ppm = 1.0

[swi]
hp_sigma = [
    4.0,
    4.0,
    0.0,
]
mip_window = 7
scaling = "tanh"
strength = 4.0
unwrap = "laplacian"

observed.machine: linux-x64, packaged source-built QSMxT with default features (deep learning enabled)
observed.basis: Exact browser exported schema_version=2 TOML, including radius_step=1. Bounds unchanged. Packaged default-feature build passed all bounds in 40 seconds.
